description: Annual national electricity generation, total and hydrogeneration, 1974-2013 is a dataset listed in Ministry for the Environment Data Service (data.mfe.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Reporting - Public. Hydroelectricity is a renewable source of electricity. It makes an important contribution to New Zealand’s energy supply and economy. This dataset relates to the "Contribution of hydroelectricity to total electricity generation" measure on the Environmental Indicators, Te taiao Aotearoa website. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Reporting - Public. It offers 1 resource(s) in table. The portal shows 2015-10-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 New Zealand. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-mfe-portal.
